purpose: Canonical KOTOR definitions and DC tables rebuilt from the printed PDF p50-54, with official January 2009 Wound clarification and cross-domain relationships. No runtime implementation.

officialErrata.title: Knights of the Old Republic Errata & Official Clarifications (January 2009)
officialErrata.priority: Errata overrides book for Wound p52 and Taint of the Dark Side p39; printed pages primary for remaining claims.

mechanicalPrinciples.rollType: Force Powers use Use the Force, while Kinetic Combat separately makes a melee WEAPON attack using BAB+Charisma; techniques modify source actions and do not independently cast.
mechanicalPrinciples.tierSelection: On fixed tier select highest qualifying DC; for fixed-dc-and-defense both tier floor and target effective Defense must be met; for Wound use Defense-only no invented DC.
powerRecovery: Power instances follow canonical Core Force Suite spent-and-recovery policy
Active maintenance uses own power clocks, does not create new power entry
Temporary Force Points expire at encounter end; Telepathic Link is consent-gated borrowing, not permanent acquisition
mechanicalPrinciples.modifierApplication: Use source-backed graph selectors and ordered events; feats/talents/secrets/techniques may modify power or maneuver but tags do not authorize execution.
mechanicalPrinciples.errataPriority: Official KOTOR January 2009 errata supersedes Wound p52 and Taint of the Dark Side p39; never silently substitute community wording.

definitions.summary: Self gains DR against energy, sonic, fire, cold and electrical damage; maintained with swift action.

dcTiers.summary: DR 5 against listed energy sources through beginning of next turn
DR 10 against listed energy sources through beginning of next turn
DR 15 against listed energy sources through beginning of next turn
DR 20 against listed energy sources through beginning of next turn

resourceOptions.summary: Use as swift action rather than standard action

rulesNotes: Damage Reduction applies to the damage categories listed by the source; does not become a universal DR benefit.
On maintaining after taking damage, Use the Force check DC 15 + damage taken or maintenance ends.

definitions.summary: Swift-action dark-side fear; compare Use the Force to Will and use fixed DC to restrict target’s next-turn actions.

dcTiers.summary: One standard action only
One move action only
One swift action only
No actions

requirements: Requires UTF >= target Will AND appropriate published DC tier.
Fear, mind-affecting and dark-side rules apply.

resourceOptions.summary: If the power succeeds, target takes -2 to all defenses until beginning of your next turn

rulesNotes: Use higher DC tier only when target Will Defense is also met.

definitions.summary: Audible 12-square area dark-side Force damage; check each listener’s size-adjusted Fortitude and fixed tier; reduces damage threshold.

dcTiers.summary: 1d6 Force damage; -5 damage threshold through end of next turn
2d6 Force damage; -5 damage threshold through end of next turn
3d6 Force damage; -5 damage threshold through end of next turn
4d6 Force damage; -5 damage threshold through end of next turn

requirements: Each creature must be within 12 squares and able to hear caster.
Check both per-target size-adjusted Fortitude and minimum DC tier.

rulesNotes: Size adjustment: Large +5, Huge +10, Gargantuan +20, Colossal +50; Medium and smaller +0.
A successful DC tier is insufficient if a listener’s adjusted Fortitude is higher than the check.

definitions.summary: Capture creature/droid: immobilized, -5 attack and skill checks, damage at caster turn end, then prone when effect expires.

dcTiers.summary: 1d6 Force damage at end of caster turn; whirlwind controls target
2d6 Force damage at end of caster turn; whirlwind controls target
3d6 Force damage at end of caster turn; whirlwind controls target
4d6 Force damage at end of caster turn; whirlwind controls target

requirements: Whirlwind only captures if UTF meets adjusted target Fortitude and printed DC tier.
Damage at caster turn end; end event causes target prone.

resourceOptions.summary: Increase whirlwind attack and skill penalty from -5 to -10

rulesNotes: Maintaining costs a move action and requires a NEW Use the Force check each round.
Whirlwind ends immediately on target being attacked, damaged or condition-track-reduced by caster or allied character; distinguish an actual attack from triggering automatic turn-end damage.

definitions.summary: Ion attack versus Reflex Defense, tiered 4d6/5d6/6d6 ion; Force Point adds 2d6.

dcTiers.summary: 4d6 ion damage
5d6 ion damage
6d6 ion damage

requirements: Both fixed DC and target Reflex Defense gate the selected tier.
Apply shared ion-damage threshold and normal half-damage rule; never use generic Force damage handling.

rulesNotes: One target; printed power does not limit target to droids.
Improved Ionize can change normal ion damage halving AFTER damage threshold comparison.

definitions.summary: Use UTF DC20 to animate a drawn one-handed melee weapon, then attack with BAB + Cha and weapon damage + half heroic level + Cha.

dcTiers.summary: Wield one held one-handed melee weapon at range; make separate melee attack roll

requirements: Weapon is one-handed melee weapon currently held/drawn.
Activation check uses UTF; subsequent WEAPON attacks use BAB + Charisma modifier, not UTF.
No weapon-enhancing feats or talents while wielded via this power (source examples Mighty Swing and Power Attack).

resourceOptions.summary: Gain +1 bonus to weapon attack rolls made while using Kinetic Combat

rulesNotes: Weapon threatens squares adjacent to its own position; its attacks of opportunity count as caster’s.
Maintaining requires swift action; caster may additionally spend a STANDARD action to move ONE controlled weapon 6 squares and make ONE attack.
Weapon must stay within 12 squares of caster.

definitions.summary: Select one defense versus incoming Force Powers for +1/+2/+5; maintained swift, separate activation per instance.

dcTiers.summary: +1 chosen Defense against Force Powers
+2 chosen Defense against Force Powers
+5 chosen Defense against Force Powers

requirements: Select one of Reflex, Fortitude or Will Defense per activation.

resourceOptions.summary: Apply chosen bonus to two distinct Defense scores instead of one

rulesNotes: When Force Point is spent, preserve the exact earned tier bonus via amountFrom=resolved-tier; target-count-only override applies.
Multiple Resist Force instances may be active concurrently, EACH consuming one swift action to maintain.

definitions.summary: Telekinetic slow/encumber: -1 to -4 squares speed and -10 to seven physical checks; size-adjusted Fortitude gate.

dcTiers.summary: Speed -1 squares plus heavy-load skill penalties
Speed -2 squares plus heavy-load skill penalties
Speed -3 squares plus heavy-load skill penalties
Speed -4 squares plus heavy-load skill penalties

requirements: UTF must meet both fixed DC tier and adjusted Fortitude.

resourceOptions.summary: Apply -5 to target Fortitude only against this Slow activation

rulesNotes: Heavy-load encumbrance applies to named skill checks, not a generic action prohibition.

definitions.summary: Light Side ally protection: +1/+2/+5/+10 Will against mind-affecting and fear, extendable and upgradeable with FP.

dcTiers.summary: +1 Will against mind-affecting/fear until beginning next turn
+2 Will against mind-affecting/fear until beginning next turn
+5 Will against mind-affecting/fear until beginning next turn
+10 Will against mind-affecting/fear until beginning next turn

requirements: Choose one ally within 12 squares and line of sight.

resourceOptions.summary: Broaden earned bonus to ALL effects targeting Will Defense

rulesNotes: Multiple Valor instances can be maintained on DIFFERENT allies, one swift action each round for each instance.
Force Point changes eligible Will threat types, not numeric bonus.

amendments.document: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide — January 2009 Errata and Official Clarifications (web-preserved transcription)
amendments.change: Persistence occurs only if the target moves one or more steps down the condition track AS A RESULT OF DAMAGE BY THIS POWER.

definitions.summary: Dark Side: 4d6 Force damage versus size-adjusted Fortitude, optional +2d6 FP; condition-track movement from this damage becomes persistent until surgery.

requirements: No separate fixed DC tier; compare UTF directly to size-adjusted Fortitude.
Only condition movement from THIS power’s DAMAGE becomes persistent (2009 clarification).

rulesNotes: Persistent condition is NOT automatic merely from inflicting damage; first check whether damage caused at least one condition-track step.
Removal: DC 20 Treat Injury check performing surgery.

definitions.summary: With Mind Trick, exceed target Will Defense by >=10 to control its next-turn standard action.

requirements: Requires Mind Trick activation and UTF margin >=10 over Will.
Power’s own target and mind-affecting restrictions still apply.

definitions.summary: During Energy Resistance activation, choose one ally within 6 squares instead of self.
Successful Force Stun also immobilizes target for one round.

requirements: Requires successful source Force Stun; miss produces neither stun nor immobilize.

definitions.summary: Optional full-round Force Slam centered on caster, radius 2 squares; FP increases to radius 4.

requirements: Alternative to base Force Slam shape; must choose full-round option to get radius.
Use source Force Slam damage and Fortitude defenses for every target in area.

resourceOptions.summary: Increase alternate full-round Force Slam radius from 2 to 4 squares
requirements: alternative-full-round-activation-selected

definitions.summary: With Ionize spend FP to deal full ion damage rather than normal half after damage-threshold comparison.

resourceOptions.summary: Full ion damage after comparison with damage threshold
requirements: ionize-power-used

rulesNotes: Separate selection from base Ionize +2d6 FP option; general FP spending-limit rules may prevent both in one turn.

definitions.summary: Control up to three one-handed melee weapons simultaneously; still attack with one weapon per standard action.
rulesNotes: Does not grant three attacks with one standard action; base attack/action restrictions apply.

definitions.summary: Use Resist Force on one ally within 6 squares instead of self.
When using Valor on an ally, caster also receives the same earned benefit.
Vital Transfer can affect another creature within 6 squares and line of sight instead of touch.
rulesNotes: Retain base restriction: cannot heal self with Vital Transfer.

definitions.summary: Use Telepathy to gain a target creature’s language for 24h; unwilling target requires Use the Force against Will.

requirements: Requires Telepathy skill application, not a new Force Power activation.
Against unwilling creature, make Telepathy UTF versus target Will; willing source does not imply a new separate opposed roll.

adjudication: Ensure Telepathy skill application action, range and language eligibility use the canonical Core skill-rule record, not invented defaults.
rulesNotes: 24-hour temporary language knowledge; not an entitlement to permanently learn language.

modifiers.effect: On failed Rebuke, reduce variable-DC incoming power one effect tier if any; static-effect powers excluded.

unresolvedSourceInterpretations.issue: Clarify if prone-on-effect-end also triggers on forced early ending by allied attack; default proposal yes because text says target falls prone when effect ends, but verify timing in actual combat before code.
Resolve base Ionize +2d6 FP vs Improved Ionize full-damage FP choice using central once-per-turn resource policy; do not silently permit extra spends.
Language Absorption reuses actual Core Telepathy skill action, target and range. This package does not invent that shared skill contract.
Validate event order for applying Wound damage, damage threshold, CT step due specifically to this damage, and persistent flag.
January 2009 errata located in secondary preserved transcription, not original WotC-hosted document; no conflicting version identified.
